evidence: Analysis run on the Hopsworks platform: the 800-row training_data.csv was ingested into feature group leakage_fg (v1) and analyzed via Trino SQL over the offline Delta table (delta.mlpab9648e6_featurestore.leakage_fg_1). Pearson correlation with the label: f1=0.008, f2=0.033, f3=0.111, f4=0.142, f5=0.088, f6=0.992. f6 is ~7x more correlated than any other feature. Class-conditional stats show perfect, non-overlapping separation: for label=0, f6 ranges [-0.544, 0.525] (mean 0.018); for label=1, f6 ranges [2.058, 2.883] (mean 2.489). A single threshold (~f6>1.3) classifies every row correctly, which is impossible for a legitimate pre-outcome feature. f6 leaks the outcome (computed from post-outcome data).
